newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedbank, Christian group to open bank.
newsitem.headline: Swedbank, Christian group to open bank.

text.p: Swedish bank Swedbank and the Christian company Dagengruppen AB will open a new bank, Samsparbanken, to increase service to Christian congregations, organisations and their members.
The bank will start operating on January 1, 1998, with Swedbank holding 60 percent and Dagengruppen 40 percent.
The deal follows a 12-year-long cooperation between the two companies, the groups said in a statement.
The move comes ahead of new rules for savings associations on December 31, 1997, which will affact Dagengruppen AB's finance and insurance operations in AB Samspar and Samspar Ekonomisk forening.
Samspar's current balance sheet total amounts to slightly over one billion crowns.
The deal is conditioned on approval from Samspar's annual general shareholders' meeting and authorities.
